title: LAION-Audio-XL: A Web-Scale Corpus and Scaling Studies for Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining
summary: Contrastive audio-text encoders were trained at five sizes on 365M samples; MAEB-30 error fell about 4% per compute doubling, with compute-optimal model sizes depending on sample budget. The finding is limited to this dataset and architecture, and concerns the scaling result rather than the dataset or model release.
